svg.text: R8b HIL bench wiring: Nucleo-H723ZG (controller) ↔ Teensy 4.1 (motor emulator)
All 3.3 V logic. Each board on its own USB. NEVER join 3V3-3V3 or 5V-VIN. Source: docs/r8b-hil-wiring.md. Pin labels: Zio name / STM32 pin, then connector pin.
→ = Nucleo drives, ← = Teensy drives (arrows in the wire label). Grey dashed box at the bottom = DAC board, later. Greyscale-safe: each group has its own line style.
DAC BOARD: build later, only for current_sense = internal (adds analog current inputs). Not needed for first runs.
Do not use Nucleo CN9-15 (D71) for gate A upper. Check MB1364 sticker and SB28, SB39, SB14/15, SB32 at default before wiring.
DAC rows: DAC SCK and SDI reuse the AD7606 SCLK / DOUTA wires (Teensy 13 / 11). Teensy GND pads: confirm on the pinout card.
